cases.input_situation: Two sites repeat one press release
cases.accept: Trace underlying evidence; website count does not establish independence or truth

cases.input_situation: A repost pairs an image with today's event and editable older metadata
cases.accept: Separate original caption, publication/event/capture dates; neither editable metadata nor signed history verifies depicted story
cases.reject: AI/camera/truth/location verdict or phone image-inspection claim

cases.input_situation: A short quotation omits surrounding qualifications
cases.accept: Read full original wording and surrounding context; literal differences alone do not establish meaning/intent/truth
A20percent B15percent; larger raw count can have lower rate; check comparability/denominators
cases.reject: Causality, significance, data quality or claim-truth conclusion
